section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1982
title: 14 ## Accidental Deaths by Age Group The accidental deaths reported during 1982 have been further analysed according to age group of victims. On the all India level the highest number of accidental deaths occurred in the age group of 18-30 years which accounted for 36·1 per cent of the total accidental deaths followed by 30-50 years age group which accounted for 28·8 per cent of the total accidental deaths. While 21·5 per cent of the total accidental deaths occurred in the age group below 18 years, 13·6 per cent deaths were recorded in the age group of above 50 years.
